description: The restored standing stone Buddha in the historic Maligawila image-house remains in Monaragala District.
description_zh: 莫讷勒格勒区马利伽维拉遗址的立佛石雕，位于古代佛像殿遗存及其公开观览区。
details: The point represents the named standing Buddha visitor area at Maligawila. The nearby Dambegoda Bodhisattva and the separate temple building are outside this point's identity.

description: The large surviving stupa at Dedigama, independently named in the provincial visitor route and national district handbook.
description_zh: 斯里兰卡德迪伽马的古佛塔遗存。省级旅游部门将原址列入公开游览信息。
